description: Open data portal of North Macedonia (data.gov.mk) is an open data portal listed in Open data portal of North Macedonia (data.gov.mk), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Government of North Macedonia. Open data portal of North Macedonia (data.gov.mk) publishes open datasets. Coverage: North Macedonia. This harvest read all datasets of the portal through its CKAN API; 4 of them are about infrastructure or natural hazards and became 2 records. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-mk.
